frequency_question: How often do announced major U.S. tariffs actually take effect on the scheduled date without being delayed, rescinded, or replaced by a negotiated agreement beforehand?
membership_rule: Includes: formally announced Section 232 or Section 301 tariff implementations or equivalent sweeping trade actions with a scheduled effective date. Excludes: purely investigative announcements with no implementation date, or routine administrative antidumping/countervailing duties.

cases.name: Proposed Tariffs on Mexico (Immigration threat) - June 2019
Restoration of Aluminum Tariffs on Canada - August 2020

coverage_note: 6 major announced tariff actions identified in the modern era with specific effective dates; 5 implemented as scheduled, 1 averted via agreement/suspension.
known_gaps: Minor adjustments or exemptions granted during implementation phases are omitted, focusing purely on whether the headline tariff took effect on schedule.
validity_reason: Base rate tied to presidential trade policy execution style; valid through the current presidential term.
